entries.why: pointer to the screen manager (object of 0x74 bytes, +0x2C the screen number): all 8 literal pool words that hold it in the Sampler sit at equal places of the synth's pools and hold 0xC03406B0 (vote 8 of 8); the user at synth 0xC006C358 allocates 0x74 bytes like the Sampler and compares +0x2C with 1 before reading the keyboard object's mode
